de: The Hundred Years War:  Joan of Arc lifts the Siege of Orléans, turning the tide of the war

dz: 百年战争：雅尔若战役的第二天，圣女贞德率领法国军队占领了这座城市，英国指挥官威廉·德拉波尔，第一代萨福克公爵。
de: Hundred Years' War: On the second day of the Battle of Jargeau, Joan of Arc leads the French army in their capture of the city and the English commander, William de la Pole, 1st Duke of Suffolk.

te: Charles VII's army defeats an English army under John Talbot at the Battle of Patay during the Hundred Years' War. The …
dz: 百年战争期间，查理七世的军队在帕泰战役中击败了约翰·塔尔伯特领导的英国军队。英国人在这一段战争中损失了 2,200 人，占其军队一半以上，削弱了他们的努力。
de: Charles VII's army defeats an English army under John Talbot at the Battle of Patay during the Hundred Years' War. The English lost 2,200 men, over half their army, crippling their efforts during this segment of the war.

t: 法国查理七世在圣女贞德的成功战役后在兰斯大教堂加冕为法国国王。
te: Charles VII of France is crowned the King of France in the Reims Cathedral after a successful campaign by Joan of Arc.
dz: 百年战争：法国查理七世在圣女贞德的成功战役后在兰斯大教堂加冕为法国国王。
de: Hundred Years' War: Charles VII of France is crowned the King of France in the Reims Cathedral after a successful campaign by Joan of Arc.
